obligations.text: Providers of very large online platforms and of very large online search engines shall put in place reasonable, proportionate and effective mitigation measures, tailored to the specific systemic risks identified pursuant to Article 34, with particular consideration to the impacts of such measures on fundamental rights.
The Board, in cooperation with the Commission, shall publish comprehensive reports, once a year.
